 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Divider color is the most frequent non-background value arranged as a
    # complete row and column; the four equal-sized panels repeat the top-left.
    divider = None
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            divider = grid[r][0]
            break
    if divider is None:
        for c in range(w):
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
            if len(set(vals)) == 1:
                divider = vals[0]
                break
    if divider is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    dr = next((r for r in range(h) if all(v == divider for v in grid[r])), None)
    dc = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))), None)
    if dr is None or dc is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Use the upper-left panel as the source and tile it into every other panel.
    for r in range(h):
        if r == dr:
            continue
        sr = r if r < dr else r - dr - 1
        for c in range(w):
            if c == dc:
                continue
            sc = c if c < dc else c - dc - 1
            out[r][c] = grid[sr][sc]
    return out
